name: Integration Opvius AI for WooCommerce
author: Opvious.ai

sections.description:
• Product content that can be generated:

    • Short description
    • Description
    • Focus keyword (SEO)
    • Meta title (SEO)
    • Meta description (SEO)

  • Blog posts

    • Frequently asked questions will be retrieved based on search volume and competition level.
    • Blog posts can be written based on the frequently asked question.

  • The plugin is compatible with Yoast SEO & RankMath SEO.

  • The functionalities of this plugin are easy:

    • Push products in bulk to the Opvius AI platform so that product content can be generated.
    • Publish the generated content automatically from Opvius AI to WooCommerce.
    • Write new blog posts based on frequently asked questions.
    • Push blog posts to WordPress automatically.

  • Regular AI tools generate, Opvius AI automates.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/integration-woosa-ai-for-woocommerce directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins section directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ section in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to ‘Opvius AI’ in the main dashboard menu to configure the plugin.
sections.faq:
What makes Opvius AI different from other AI tools?

Regular AI tools will generate, and Opvius AI will automate. That means the generation, editing, and publishing process, will be fully automated from Opvius AI to WooCommerce.

What is the price of Opvius AI?

Opvius AI starts from €10 a month for 10.000 credits. 1 credit = 1 word, which we only count for the output of the generated content (not the input).

Will I own the generated content?

Yes, once the content has been generated we will publish it to your WooCommerce store. The content will be yours.

Can I edit the generated content?

Yes, you can edit it before publishing it to WooCommerce from the Opvius AI portal or manually via WooCommerce.
